crossRefs.note: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.
As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is…
By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in…

translations.web: The great court around had three courses of cut stone, and a course of cedar beams; like the inner court of Yahweh’s house and the porch of the house.
translations.bsb: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
translations.asv: And the great court round about had three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams; like as the inner court of the house of Jehovah, and the porch of the house.
